# <span id="aanchor431"></span> Service Queues

## Tab Details

#### Queue Data Tab

The following object processing options are available on the Queue Data tab:

- **Object Selector** - Use the Object Selector at the top to select the object to queue. Alternately, the radio buttons on the left can be used to select the type of object.

- **Action Selector** - This unlabeled group box in the lower left provides a choice of actions that can be applied to the selected object.

- **Rollup** - Select this option to create a rollup queue entry. For sources, a notification message will display if the selected source has not been enabled for rollups. Rollup queues are processed by Meter Rollup, Location Rollup, Source Rollup, and Calculated Meter services. This option is always enabled and selected by default.
  - **Roll Data For** - These options are only available for lists or locations; they are disabled for meters, sources, and source lists.

    - For list objects, the following selections are available:
      - **Meters and locations in this list only.** This option will only queue the immediate members of the list. It will not queue entries for meters or locations nested within locations in the list.
      - **All meters in this list and member locations.** This option will queue immediate meters in the list and iteratively examine nested locations for meter-type members. Ultimately, only the lowest level meters will be queued.
      - **Lowest-level locations only.** This option will iteratively examine nested locations for location-type members. Ultimately, only the lowest level locations will be queued.
    - For location objects, the following selections are available:
      - **This location only.** This option will only queue the selected location.
      - **Top-level member meters and locations in this location only.** This option will only queue the immediate members of the location. It will not queue entries for meters or locations nested within the selected.
      - **All meters in this location and member locations.** This option will queue the immediate meter members of the selected location and iteratively examine nested locations for meter-type members. Ultimately, only the lowest level meters will be queued.
      - **Lowest-level locations only.** This option will iteratively examine nested locations for location-type members. Ultimately, only the lowest level locations will be queued.

  - **Check for Data Within the Range** - Select this option to only queue periods in which data exists. When this option is not selected, the entire period will be queued for rollup, even when data does not exist.

- **HCDP Calc** - Select this option for a source or source list to create an HCDP queue entry. A notification message will display if the selected source has not been enabled for hydrocarbon dew point or cricondentherm calculations. The HCDP queue is processed by the HCDP service (FcSrvHCDPQueueProcessor.exe).

  This feature requires the Source Analysis module.

- **Queue Location** - Queues a location to close a selected month/year. The Location Close queue is processed by the Location Close service (FcSrvLcnCloseData.exe).

- **Batch Matching** - As batches are imported for meters with the Reconcile Batches option enabled (**Meter Editor** \> **Liquids** tab), FLOWCAL will try to match each batch to a [scheduled batch movement](../../Imports/Scheduled%20Batch%20Movement/Scheduled%20Batch%20Movement.md). The Batch Matching queue is processed by the Batch Scheduling Matching service (FcSrvBatchScheduleMatching.exe).

  This feature requires the Liquids add-on.

- **Source Apply** – This option queues sources to be applied to meters. The Source apply queue is processed by the Source Apply service (FcSrvGQTrans.exe)

  This feature requires the Source Analysis module.
